title: fix(app-shell): the object / data previews and the federated datasource panel read the designer locale (objectui#10862, slice 3)
body:
Part of #10862
Clause-②: no — rows are added and a locale is passed; each en row equals today's literal. No declared surface or stored value moves.

Slice 3 of 3 (the object / data previews), per triage `5860733428`, seat 4's release `5863137337` and the slice-1 / slice-2 ACCEPTs `5861649175` / `5862348719`. Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM (claim `5863389454`, session `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`), implemented on `claude/issue-10862-designer-english-slice-3` from `main` `35d68c4`. Same shape as objectui#10832 / #10850 / #10857 / #10871 / #10880: `engine.*` rows whose en value is the literal each replaces, plus zh, read in the designer locale the surface receives. No second catalogue.

**This PR leaves the card open.** The dispatch made this the card's final slice unless a family site is still English after it. The census below found nine more files outside this slice's list that still render English under zh-CN (listed under Acceptance notes), so the first line is `Part of`, and objectui#10862 remains open as their carrier.

## What changed

All under `packages/app-shell/src/views/`.

- **`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`**: 140 en rows (each equal to the literal it replaces, byte for byte) and 140 zh rows, placeholders identical. Three existing rows are reused with the same meaning: `designer.canvas.renameHint` (the canvas rename tooltip), `engine.inspector.add.block` (the add-block trigger, the label `PagePreview`'s outline strip already reads) and `engine.inspector.view.object` (the view preview's no-object code span, the label the view inspector shows that field under).
- **The registered previews** (`previews/ObjectPreview.tsx`, `DatasetPreview.tsx`, `ViewPreview.tsx`, `ReportPreview.tsx`, `PagePreview.tsx`, `ValidationPreview.tsx`) read their rows in the `locale` prop their hosts already pass. Every `fallbackHint` literal in `previews/` now reads a row: the ten the card counted in seven files. `DashboardPreview` and `FlowPreview` already read `engine.dashboardPreview.malformed` / `engine.flowPreview.malformed`, so they are recorded, not changed. A sentence around a code span is one row whose hole `withNodes` (`previews/row-nodes.ts`) fills: the view preview's no-object note, whose code span now shows the right panel's field label (`engine.inspector.view.object`) in the same locale, and the validation preview's removed-type sentence.
- **`previews/PageBlockCanvas.tsx`** and **`previews/block-types.ts`**: the canvas's own words, plus the add-block picker's category headings and block names. `BLOCK_TYPE_META` entries gain a `labelKey` (the add-widget picker's shape from objectui#10804); `CATEGORY_LABEL_EN` becomes `CATEGORY_LABEL_KEY`, its en rows the English it carried. The picker's search matches the displayed name or the type id. `label` stays as the English name.
- **`previews/SourcePageEditor.tsx`**: the textarea label and the preview hint.
- **The column manager**: `previews/FieldsListEditor.tsx` (heading, empty note, positional label) and `FieldListRow` in `previews/ViewColumnPanes.tsx` (the remove control). `previews/view-column-io.ts` `colLabel` takes an optional positional formatter, so the `col N` fallback reads the designer row where it renders while the module stays free of the string tables (its default is unchanged).
- **`metadata-admin/external/ExternalDatasourcePanel.tsx`** (carried from slice 2's ACCEPT): its own nine sites.
- **Locale threading**: `PagePreview` passes its `locale` to `PageBlockCanvas` and `SourcePageEditor`; `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` passes its own to its three `SourcePageEditor` mounts; `previews/DatasourcePreview.tsx` passes its `locale` to `ExternalDatasourcePanel`.
- `celAuthoring.ts` is untouched: no static import is added to it.
- One `.changeset/10862-designer-object-data-previews-locale.md` (`patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell`).

## H1 census, confirmed per file

Read at source per file, then each hit confirmed as rendered by a pin through the real component. A site is one rendered designer word: an element's text, a `title`, an `aria-label` or a `placeholder`.

| file | rows | rendered sites | not counted, and why |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `ObjectPreview` | 1 | 1 | `hint` props (`PreviewShell` no longer renders them) |
| `DatasetPreview` | 15 | 15 | `hint`; the error banner (the server's text); header labels and cell values (field metadata and data) |
| `ViewPreview` | 4 (+1 reused) | 4 | `hint` (three); the reused row fills the no-object note's code span inside that note's own site |
| `ReportPreview` | 6 | 6 | `hint` |
| `PagePreview` | 8 | 8 | `hint`; the regions-shaped outline fallback `region N · M` (a regions page in design mode renders the block canvas, never the outline strip, so it cannot show); record labels (data) |
| `PageBlockCanvas` + `block-types` | 55 (+2 reused) | 57 | region and slot names, block ids, type badges and region widths (author data); the `region_N` names `addRegion` writes (stored); `blockLabel`'s `block` fallback (only a component with no `type`, which `PageComponent` refuses); the `AI` heading (routed through a row whose zh is `AI`, as the metadata domain table's is); the `misc` heading (no block type is in that category, so it never renders) |
| `SourcePageEditor` | 2 | 2 | `hint`; Monaco's model path |
| `ValidationPreview` | 36 | 36 | `hint`; the severity, rule-type and event tokens (stored enum values); a bare `JSON Schema` title (the standard's name); the `—` of an absent otherwise; label, name, description, message, tags, states, fields, regex and CEL sources (author data) |
| `FieldsListEditor` | 3 | 3 | column labels and field names (author data) |
| `ViewColumnPanes` | 1 | 1 | `ColumnChip`'s own `Remove …` label: `ColumnChip` has no production importer (dead export; see Acceptance notes) |
| `ExternalDatasourcePanel` | 9 | 9 | the `schemaMode` token (stored value); the snapshot time (display-locale formatting, objectui#9909's channel); a refresh failure's own message (producer text) |

Totals: 140 new rows, 142 rendered sites (`Add region` and `Select …` each render at two places; the two canvas reused rows add two sites; the third reused row adds none, being part of the view preview's no-object site), every site pinned. The `AI` and `misc` heading rows are the two rows not counted as sites.

## H2: every production host passes the locale

- **The registered previews** read the `locale` prop. Every registered-preview mount passes `useMetadataLocale()`: `ResourceEditPage` (`PreviewComponent … locale={locale}`), `EmbeddedItemEditor` (`Preview … locale={locale}`), `StudioDesignSurface` (the interfaces pillar's `Preview` and the automations pillar's `React.createElement(Preview, {…, locale})`).
- **`PageBlockCanvas`** has one host, `PagePreview`, which now passes the `locale` it receives at both mounts.
- **`SourcePageEditor`** has two hosts: `PagePreview` (split mode, now passes `locale`) and `StudioDesignSurface` (preview mode on the canvas, editor mode twice in the inspector; each now passes the surface's `useMetadataLocale()` value).
- **`ExternalDatasourcePanel`** has one host, `DatasourcePreview`, which now passes its `locale`.
- **The column manager** (`FieldsListEditor`, `FieldListRow`) reads `useMetadataLocale()`, as the add-field popover rendered beside those rows (`AddFieldPopover`, same file as `FieldListRow`) already did. Its hosts (`ViewColumnInspector`, `ViewVariantInspector`, `ReportDefaultInspector`) hold the same hook's value, so no host edit was needed.

## Pins

Two new files, all mounting the real component under `I18nProvider` in the case's language: `previews/dataPreviews.i18n-10862-s3.test.tsx` (54 cases) and `previews/externalDatasourcePanel.i18n-10862-s3.test.tsx` (8 cases). `PageBlockCanvas` and `SourcePageEditor` are mounted through `PagePreview`, `ExternalDatasourcePanel` through `DatasourcePreview`, so the cases also read the threading. Every zh expectation is read back from the catalogue and guarded by `zhRow` (neither the echoed key nor the en row); every en case reads the en row through `t` / `tFormat` for `en-US`. A case reads every site on every mount before it judges, so a failing case lists each missing site. The error-boundary hints show through stand-ins that throw on demand (`SchemaRenderer`, the chart and report renderers, `ObjectFormCanvas`, `InterfaceListPage`), each mock spreading the real module; the report's loading text shows through a stand-in that suspends.

- **Red run on the base** (the 15 changed sources checked out at `35d68c4`, blobs equal base; `i18n.ts` and the pins at HEAD `497678c`; trap restore, blobs equal HEAD, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, porcelain 0 lines): `Tests 31 failed | 31 passed (62)`. The 31 failures are the 30 zh cases plus the one case that reads the new `labelKey` / `CATEGORY_LABEL_KEY` wiring. The 30 zh cases list 151 missing sites covering 140 distinct keys: 138 of the 140 new rows (all but the `AI` and `misc` headings named above) and the two canvas reused rows; the third reused row is read inside the no-object case's code-span check. All 30 en controls pass against the base sources, and so does the unit case that compares every block name's en row with the English the table carries, so each en row renders exactly what the literal rendered.
- **Ablation** through `ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode) on `PagePreview.tsx`: the `locale` thread to the region canvas cut (anchor 1 to 0, blob `e2f4198` to `6ba718f`) gives `Tests 5 failed | 49 passed (54)`. The five are exactly the zh `PageBlockCanvas` cases; every en case stays green. Restored: blob equals HEAD `e2f4198`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The pins import sources by relative path, so no `dist` sits between mutation and run.
- **Green at HEAD `497678c`**: the two pin files with `FieldsListEditor.retiredAliases`, `view-column-io.retiredAliases` and `clientValidation.skew` (the slice-1 skew test), `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 77 passed (77)`.

## Consumer sweep

- **Static closure**: a base-vs-HEAD import-graph diff over every test file in the repo (vitest alias map, static non-type imports). Five tests' closures grow, each by `previews/row-nodes.ts` alone (it imports only `react`): `EmbeddedItemEditor.preview`, `ValidationPreview.test`, `ViewPreview.optionsFold-7928`, `emptyCollection-8570` and the new pin file. The new `ExternalDatasourcePanel` edge to `i18n.ts` grows no test's closure (every test reaching the panel already reaches `i18n.ts`). `celAuthoring.ts` gains no import.
- **Full-replacement mocks**: an AST census of `vi.mock` / `vi.doMock` of `@objectstack/spec/ui`, `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/i18n` across the 455 tests whose closure reaches a changed module: 33 sites, all spread the real module; positive control: the same recogniser flags `clientValidation.skew.test.tsx`'s `@objectstack/spec/ui` mock (outside that set) as a full replacement. Every mock of the designer `i18n` module inherits it too.
- **Literal readers**: a whole-repo scan of test files for the 140 replaced en literals finds 82 tests inside that 455 set (most on short common words); the ones that read this slice's sentences (`DatasetPreview.test`, `PageBlockCanvas.test`, `ReportPreview.dataset`, `ValidationPreview.test`, `page-preview-record-type-10482`, `palette-discussion-alias`, `emptyCollection-8526` / `-8570`, `inspectorStrings.i18n-10586`, `EmbeddedItemEditor.preview`) mount in en and see the same words. Outside the set, `e2e/live/studio-editor.spec.ts` matches `/Add block/i` against a live en console, unchanged by construction.
- **The run**: all 455 tests whose closure reaches a changed module, plus the 17 `previews/` suites outside that set and the skew control, in seven locked batches at `f19d127` (the code of HEAD; later commits touch only the changeset and a test type): `Test Files 76 passed (76)` six times and `Test Files 17 passed (17)` once: 473 files, 4665 tests passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped (a pre-existing conditional skip in `flow-node-config.spec-reconciliation`). Every batch `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Type check** at HEAD `497678c`: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` (28 of 28 tasks), then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (script echoed: `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), `VERDICT command-exit 0`; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both pin files.

## Gates (at HEAD `497678c`, each exit 0)

`check:i18n-designer-parity` (Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders.) · `check:i18n-drift` (140 key(s) added, 0 en values changed) · `check:i18n-keys` · `check:designer-field-key-parity` · `check:control-bytes` · `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations) · `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `check:vi-mock-inherit` / `check:vi-mock-override-shape` · `check:test-path-roots` · `check:unreferenced-sources` · `check:icon-record-names` · `check:esm-specifiers` · `check:self-import` · `check:phantom-deps` · `check:handler-key-reads` · `check:metadata-write-doors` · `check:action-forward-parity` · `check:element-data-source-declaration` · `check:prompt-keys` · `check:changeset-claims` (report-only: five pending changesets name a touched file, 6310, 6681, 7125, 8632 and `rotten-pugs-invent`; each paragraph read, still true) · `check:pending-changeset-literals` · `check-changeset-presence` · `check-changeset-no-major` · `check-changeset-fixed` · `check-changeset-overwrite` · `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT GOVERNED, 19 paths) · `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only; none of the 140 new rows listed).

ESLint on the 18 changed source and test files (`--format json`, 18 files): 0 errors. Every modified file carries the same error and warning counts as its base blob, with and without `--no-inline-config`; the two new test files carry none. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `project` / `projectService` in the resolved parser options) and no local rule reads the disk, so no untouched file can change verdict.

NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-closure` and `check:eager-locale-catalogues` (both read a console build; the latter printed PREREQUISITE NOT MET here); the console performance budget (CI's). A browser drive of the preview gallery, whose `I18nProvider` mounts in `en` (the dev-harness gap the card names as out of scope).

## Serial

- PR objectui#10888's `previews/__tests__/block-config-schema-parity-8216.test.ts` is untouched (it has since merged).
- Open PRs' file lists re-read before the first edit (10 open, the release PR among them) and before opening this PR (6 open): no file in common with this branch.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree` of HEAD against a fresh `origin/main` `9f0c84a`: exit 0, no conflict. Re-run at fix round 1 (HEAD `6a21fd3`) against a fresh `origin/main` `8522396`: exit 0, tree `8ac1563`, and no file main changed since the base is in this PR's diff.

## Fix round 1 (HEAD `6a21fd3`)

Contract review at `497678c` returned wording findings only; this round takes all of them in one commit.

- **Glossary, zh only, each now the catalogue's existing term**: `engine.pageBlockCanvas.type.recordRelatedList` 关联列表 (as `engine.inspector.pageBlock.option.location.record_related` and `engine.inspector.action.location.record_related`); `engine.validationPreview.transitions` 状态流转, `.transitionsOn` `{field} 的状态流转`, `.noTransitions` 未声明任何状态流转。 (as the rules editor's `engine.studio.rules.transitions` / `.typeStateMachine`); `engine.pagePreview.sampleOne` / `.sampleOther` `{count} 条示例` (示例记录, as `engine.actionPreview.placement.sampleRecord` and `perm.cel.test.record`); `engine.pageBlockCanvas.itemN` 第 {n} 项. No en row moves; placeholders unchanged.
- **Changeset**: the page-block-canvas bullet now names the sites converted (region and container labels; the no-regions, empty-region, inherited-slot and empty-group states; the add-region and add-block buttons; drop target, rename tooltip, select labels, each block's render-failure hint; the picker's search box, headings and names) and no longer claims slot labels, which show as written, as the closing paragraph says.
- **Pins** read every zh value from the catalogue, so none needed an edit; none hard-codes 相关列表, 状态转换 or 样本.
- **Re-run at `6a21fd3`**: the two pin files with `ValidationPreview.test`, `PageBlockCanvas.test`, `palette-discussion-alias` and `page-preview-record-type-10482` under the verify lock, `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 95 passed (95)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `check:i18n-designer-parity` (Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders.), `check:i18n-drift` (140 key(s) added, 0 en values changed), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT GOVERNED, 19 paths): each exit 0.
- **Not taken**: a pin for `StudioDesignSurface`'s three `SourcePageEditor` `locale` threads. Mounting `StudioDesignSurface` needs its own scaffolding (router, metadata client, pillar state), which no existing pin file carries, so it would not be one case in an existing file. The threads are read by review and by `tsc`, not by a test.

## Acceptance notes

- **The family is not closed: nine files outside this slice still render English under zh-CN** (read at source, not driven in a browser), which is why this PR says `Part of`:
  - `metadata-admin/external/SchemaBrowser.tsx`, `ValidationPanel.tsx`, `ImportObjectDialog.tsx`: the federated panel's tab contents and import dialog never read the designer `t` (the filter placeholder, the Refresh button, the table headers, Import, the unavailable hint, the ten diff-kind labels, Run validation, the match summaries, the dialog's title, labels and buttons).
  - `previews/FlowCanvas.tsx`: the edge tooltips (the un-declared-cycle sentence, `(back-edge)`) and the approval node summary (`N approver(s)`, `· all`).
  - `previews/FlowPreview.tsx`: the variables panel's `in` / `out` tags.
  - `previews/FlowRunsPanel.tsx`: an expanded run's `run …` / `· trigger …` line.
  - `previews/FieldStub.tsx`: the address field's placeholder (`Street / City, State ZIP / Country`).
  - `previews/useObjectFields.ts` (`Object not found`, shown inside the localized `engine.form.noObjectFields` sentence) and `previews/useDatasetCatalog.ts` (`Dataset not found`, the dashboard widget inspector's error slot).
- **Files outside the claim's listed files**: `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and `previews/DatasourcePreview.tsx` (one `locale` attribute each, the threading the claim names), `previews/block-types.ts` (the picker's name table) and `previews/view-column-io.ts` (the optional positional formatter). Same defect class, no other behaviour.
- `ColumnChip` in `previews/ViewColumnPanes.tsx` keeps its English `Remove …` label: nothing in the product imports it (dead export), so it is neither counted nor converted.
- Pending changesets `8570-inline-empty-markers` ("the wording of both sentences is preserved", about the validation preview's `none`) and `palette-canonical-discussion-5495` (the label "Discussion") stay true in en; in zh the same words now read `无` and `讨论`.
- `ActionPreview` still carries its own copy of `withNodes` from slice 1 (a refactor, not a locale fix).
- The preview gallery still mounts `I18nProvider` in `en` (out of scope, as the card says).
- `ExternalDatasourcePanel` stores its federation-unavailable sentence in state when a refresh fails, so after a language switch that sentence keeps the old language until the next refresh (review note, not changed).
